caption: The drawing depicts a single glass cup with two handles, centrally positioned on a plain, light beige background. The cup is tinted with a purple hue and has a translucent appearance, allowing some light to pass through. The surface of the cup is adorned with a decorative floral pattern consisting of small, leafy branches. The handles, located on the left and right sides, are also rendered in the same purple glass. The bottom of the cup features a circular, radial pattern. Below the cup to the right, the name "Stewart" is written in brown text. The composition is minimal, with the cup being the only object depicted and a large expanse of empty space surrounding it.
title: Sugar Bowl
